verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable deployment of Agentic Commerce Suite. It is documented as a Stripe-hosted service: Stripe handles routing and SPT creation, and payments settle to the Stripe balance. The open ACP and MPP specifications and the open-source Link CLI client are adjacent building blocks, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
